items.title: Fred Radke interviewed by Monk Rowe, Hillsdale, Michigan, November 8, 2023
items.q: Harry James is a bugler that doesn't play... And he goes to Betty Grable, who is also on the set... So Harry and Betty Grable adopted Corky Corcoran so he could stay in the band

ctx.x: And well I’ll get to that in a second. But so I’m sitting on the band. The reason I left the band, I had an offer from a friend of mine to start the jazz department at North Seattle Community College, a brand new college. And I’m sitting there. And when I joined Harry I thought, you know everybody says wow isn’t it great to be on there. You know I said I’m going to analyze him. I want to be — I want to know what makes him tick. What makes him not only a very famous band and very charismatic and he and Betty…
